09. QuickSight Dashboard

Dashboard vision

The project will provide a BMW analytics dashboard with KPIs and regional trends.

Planned KPIs

  • Total vehicles

  • Total telemetry events

  • Average battery level

  • Average battery temperature

  • Critical fault count

  • Total warranty cost

Planned visuals

  • telemetry events by month

  • vehicle activity by region

  • fault distribution

  • average battery by model

  • average temperature by region

  • maintenance cost by model

  • critical-fault vehicle table

Prerequisites

QuickSight may require an activated account and an authorized user or role.
